styles.name: Cute
styles.vibe: Pinterest-cute for women 20-45: sweet and grown-up, never sexy or childish. Gingham, bows, puff sleeves, pearl buttons, lace trim; knee/midi skirts, regular tops, relaxed fit. No bodycon, plunge or low rise.
accessories: mini shoulder bag with a bow

styles.name: Cozy
styles.vibe: Soft and warm: oatmeal, cream and camel, chunky cable knits, sherpa and fleece, oversized cuts, rib cuffs, drawstrings, horn buttons.

styles.name: Clean girl
styles.vibe: Polished and effortless: cream, beige and white, ribbed jersey, fitted basics, minimal seams, small gold hoops, no logos or prints.

styles.name: Downtown girl
styles.vibe: Effortless city cool: black, brown and grey, leather, oversized blazers, baggy jeans, silver chunky jewelry, slouchy shoulder bags, almost no cute details.

styles.name: Pilates princess
styles.vibe: Soft, sculpted and serene: ballet pink and soft pastels, seamless sculpting knits, ruching, crossover straps, wide waistbands, delicate gold jewelry.

styles.name: Trendy
styles.vibe: Of the moment: cargo pockets, mesh, cropped cuts, low rise, mixed silver and gold hardware, bag charms.

styles.name: Officewear
styles.vibe: Sharp and polished: tailored wool suiting, structured shoulders, welt and flap pockets, horn buttons, navy, charcoal, camel and ivory, structured leather totes.

styles.name: Coquette
styles.vibe: Romantic and feminine: blush, ivory and satin pink, lace trim, satin bows everywhere, pearl buttons, corset lacing, ruffles.

styles.name: Y2K
styles.vibe: Early 2000s pop: baby pink, baby blue and chrome, velour tracksuits, low-rise flares, baby tees with graphics, butterflies, rhinestones, logo plates.

styles.name: Old money
styles.vibe: Understated wealth: navy, cream, camel and forest green, cashmere and cable knits, tweed and wool, gold crest buttons, pearl studs, no visible logos.

styles.name: Streetwear
styles.vibe: Oversized and graphic: black, heather grey and olive with a loud accent, heavyweight jersey and fleece, nylon, back prints, rib cuffs, cargo pockets, drawcords.

styles.name: Boho
styles.vibe: Free-spirited 70s: terracotta, rust, mustard and cream, suede fringe, crochet and lace, floral embroidery, tie necklines, tiered ruffles, turquoise and antique gold.

styles.name: Sporty
styles.vibe: Clean athletic: white, navy and heather grey with a red or royal stripe, jersey, mesh and nylon, side piping, rib collars, zip pulls, drawcords, pleated tennis skirts.

styles.name: Minimalist
styles.vibe: Pared back: black, white, camel and grey, quality jersey, wool and leather, concealed closures, fine tonal stitching, no decoration or logos.

styles.name: Grunge
styles.vibe: Worn-in and dark: black, charcoal, oxblood and olive, leather, washed denim, mesh, moto snaps and zips, heavy topstitching, gunmetal hardware, chains and O-rings.

styles.name: Preppy
styles.vibe: Crisp collegiate: navy, white, kelly green and pink, oxford cotton, cable knits, quilted vests, cricket stripes, gold buttons, pleats and small embroidered motifs.

styles.name: Coastal
styles.vibe: Breezy seaside: white, navy, sky blue and sand, linen and cotton, fisherman cable knits, mother-of-pearl buttons, drawstring waists, roomy canvas totes.

styles.name: Cottagecore
styles.vibe: Pastoral and handmade: sage, cream, butter and dusty rose, gingham, linen and lace, puff sleeves, ruffles, smocking, wooden buttons, floral and cherry embroidery.

styles.name: Western
styles.vibe: Rodeo heritage: tan suede, brown leather, cream and denim with turquoise, fringe, pearl snaps, pointed flap pockets, yoke piping, big belt buckles, silver.

styles.name: Mob wife
styles.vibe: Maximal glamour: black, espresso, burgundy and gold, faux fur and leather, satin, velvet and lace, fur collars and cuffs, chunky gold hardware, big statement jewelry.

styles.name: Workwear
styles.vibe: Rugged utility: duck brown, khaki, navy and olive, heavy canvas and denim, corduroy collars, triple contrast topstitching, bar tacks, rivets, flap chest pockets, brass hardware.
